info.title: dotnet-tenantguard
info.description: dotnet tenantguard validate: runs TenantGuard's model rules on a compiled app's DbContext in CI, without starting the app or opening a database connection.

options.name: --assembly
options.description: The assembly that holds the DbContext (required)

options.name: --startup-assembly
options.description: The app's entry assembly, when the context lives in a class library

options.name: --context
options.description: The context's name or full name; needed when there is more than one

options.name: --help
options.description:
Show this help
Arguments after -- go to the app, as they do with dotnet ef.
Exit codes: 0 no errors, 1 errors (or warnings under --warnings-as-errors), 2 couldn't validate.
